_meta.description: Saved-response examples injected into the dist v2.1 JSON export by export_json.js. Keyed by request path relative to the collection root. `code` = HTTP status, `status` = HTTP reason, `language` = Postman preview language. Values are sandbox-shaped samples: fields and enum values follow the collection's live-verified captures and the SDK OpenAPI spec; long payloads are truncated with ellipses. Error messages marked (observed) come from live gateway telemetry recorded in the SDK error registry; others are close paraphrases of the documented meaning.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.name: Success — hosted checkout page (HTML 200)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.description: Purchase success is NOT JSON: PayWay returns the hosted checkout page itself (HTTP 200, text/html). The test script saves {{last_tran_id}} and the Visualize tab renders the form-POST launcher. Pay with a sandbox test card (folder 01), then send 3. Check Transaction.
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.body: …

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.name: Business error — wrong hash (code 1)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.description: Business errors are HTTP 200 JSON with a non-00 status.code. Code 1 = HMAC mismatch: open the Console, compare the b4hash: line with the hash order in the request description (field order, USD 2-decimals / KHR integer amounts, base64 — not hex).

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.name: Business error — duplicated tran_id (code 4)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/1. Purchase (Hos.description: tran_id already exists for this merchant. The pre-request always generates a fresh unique tran_id — this error usually means a variable was hand-set to a previously used value. Note: gateway status.code types are mixed string/number across endpoints; the test scripts normalize both.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/2. Get Transacti.name: Success — APPROVED transaction (code 00)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/2. Get Transacti.description: Full record, including history for both online and in-store payments. payment_status_code: 0=APPROVED/PRE-AUTH, 2=PENDING, 3=DECLINED, 4=REFUNDED, 7=CANCELLED. There is no EXPIRED/CLOSED status remotely — long-PENDING is the gateway's terminal representation for expired transactions.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.name: APPROVED (payment_status_code 0)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.description: The query status lives in status.code ("00" = lookup worked); the PAYMENT status lives in data.payment_status_code. This fast endpoint only sees transactions created in the last 7 days and cannot see KHQR/QR-created transactions — use 2. Get Transaction Details for those.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.name: PENDING (payment_status_code 2) — keep polling
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.description: PENDING can persist up to ~24h; poll with delay (Flow A in folder 11 does this). Do not treat a missing callback as proof of non-payment — callbacks are single best-effort; this inquiry is the source of truth.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.name: Not found (code 6)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/3. Check Transac.description: No transaction with this tran_id inside the 7-day window (message paraphrased). KHQR transactions always answer this way here — use Get Transaction Details instead.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.name: Success (code 00)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.description: The transaction no longer accepts payment. Customer-side the QR scan is refused; keep a local closed flag — no read API reports a CLOSED status.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.name: Transaction not found (code 5)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.description: (observed) The tran_id does not exist on this merchant.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.name: Already paid — not closable (code 2)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/4. Close Transac.description: (observed) Closing an already PAID transaction answers HTTP 403 code 2. Only OPEN/PENDING transactions can be closed — refund instead.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.name: Success (code 00)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.description: Full or partial refund within 30 days of creation. ABA PAY and KHQR refunds are immediate; Card/WeChat/Alipay follow your agreement. Partial refunds: set {{refund_amount}} below the paid amount.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.name: Transaction not found or invalid (PTL36)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.description: (observed) Verify the original tran_id — refunds need a captured transaction.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.name: Status/amount mismatch (PTL57)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/5. Refund - RSA.description: (observed) Check BOTH the transaction status (Get Transaction Details) and that {{refund_amount}} fits paid − already-refunded.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/6. Transaction L.name: Success — filtered rows (code 00)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/6. Transaction L.description: Dates are gateway time UTC+7 and must be `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` (auto-filled by the pre-request). Unpaid QR-only transactions never appear; unpaid purchase-channel ones do. The gateway spells DECLINED as `DECLINDED` in list rows — handle its typo. Sample rates/values illustrative.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/6. Transaction L.name: Invalid date format (code 49)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/6. Transaction L.description: (observed) Dates must be `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss` — plain `yyyy-mm-dd` is rejected. The pre-request auto-fills today 00:00:00 → 23:59:59.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/7. Exchange Rate.name: Success (code 00)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/7. Exchange Rate.description: Rates mirror ababank.com/en/forex-exchange, keyed by lowercase currency code. Rates below are illustrative samples.

03 - Ecommerce Checkout/7. Exchange Rate.name: Invalid merchant profile (code 26)
03 - Ecommerce Checkout/7. Exchange Rate.description: (observed) The merchant_id is not recognized in this environment — check {{merchant_id}} / the sandbox vs production base URL.

04 - ABA QR API/Generate QR.request.yaml.name: Success — KHQR payload (code 0)
04 - ABA QR API/Generate QR.request.yaml.description: generate-qr reports numeric code 0 (most purchase-path endpoints report string "00" — normalize both). Render {{qr_image_template}} for the PNG template. The QR stays PENDING until paid; poll with transaction-detail (folder 11 Flow A). Image data-URL truncated here.

04 - ABA QR API/Generate QR.request.yaml.name: Lifetime elapsed before payment (code 21)
04 - ABA QR API/Generate QR.request.yaml.description: (observed) The transaction/QR lifetime elapsed before the payment completed — create a fresh transaction. Match --lifetime to the polling budget; there is no EXPIRED status to query afterwards.

05 - Payment Link/Create Payment Link.re.name: Success — link created (code 00)
05 - Payment Link/Create Payment Link.re.description: Live-captured shape. Save data.id (the test does → {{payment_link_id}}): it is the ONLY valid key for Details/Void — never the merchant ref or URL slug. Share data.payment_link; expiry is enforced merchant-side. Sample id/URL from a real sandbox capture.

05 - Payment Link/Create Payment Link.re.name: Validation rejected (PTL04)
05 - Payment Link/Create Payment Link.re.description: (observed) PTL04 is the catch-all create rejection — amount < 0.01 USD / < 100 KHR, past or < 5-minute expired_date, unsupported currency, malformed payout total.

05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.name: OPEN — unpaid link (code 00)
05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.description: Consumes {{payment_link_id}} saved by Create. Unpaid links keep reading OPEN even after expiry — enforce expiry merchant-side.

05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.name: VOIDED — after Void
05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.description: VOIDED is a real status in detail output; the hosted page then renders the invalid-data shell (code 07) and the customer form is dead.

05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.name: Unknown link id (code 96)
05 - Payment Link/Get Payment Link Detai.description: (observed) A bogus id answers 96, not the documented PTL132. Pass the opaque data.id from Create — not merchant_ref_no, not the URL slug.

05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.name: Success — link voided (code 00)
05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.description: Permanently cancels an UNPAID link — irreversible. tran_id here is the numeric gateway log id, not a payment transaction. Confirm with Get Payment Link Details (status reads VOIDED). Do not void paid links — refund instead.

05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.name: Already voided (PTL188) — terminal, not an error
05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.description: (observed) Void is NOT idempotent: a second void on the same link always answers 403 PTL188. Treat it as the desired terminal state.

05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.name: Unknown link id (code 96)
05 - Payment Link/Void Payment Link.requ.description: (observed) The id does not reference a known payment link on this merchant.

06 - Pre-auth/1. Complete Pre-auth.reque.name: Success — funds captured (code 00)
06 - Pre-auth/1. Complete Pre-auth.reque.description: Captures a pre-authorization. Default capture window is 30 days, after which the hold auto-releases — with no webhook, so track the window merchant-side.

06 - Pre-auth/1. Complete Pre-auth.reque.name: Status/amount mismatch (PTL59)
06 - Pre-auth/1. Complete Pre-auth.reque.description: (observed) The transaction is not in a capturable state (never authorized, already completed/cancelled) or the completion amount is incorrect.

06 - Pre-auth/3. Cancel Pre-auth.request.name: Success — hold released (code 00)
06 - Pre-auth/3. Cancel Pre-auth.request.description: Releases the temporary hold on the customer's payment method.

06 - Pre-auth/3. Cancel Pre-auth.request.name: Not cancellable (PTL170)
06 - Pre-auth/3. Cancel Pre-auth.request.description: (observed) Only OPEN/PENDING pre-auths can be cancelled — check the current status first.

07 - Payout/1. Payout (to beneficiaries).name: Success — payout queued (code 0)
07 - Payout/1. Payout (to beneficiaries).description: Payout reports numeric code 0. Payouts settle immediately; there is NO standard refund after a payout or split — verify beneficiaries before sending.

07 - Payout/1. Payout (to beneficiaries).name: Payee not whitelisted (code 37)
07 - Payout/1. Payout (to beneficiaries).description: (observed) Whitelist the payee first (request 2 in this folder) and match the currency to the beneficiary account.

07 - Payout/2. Add Account to Payout Whi.name: Success — payee whitelisted (code 00)
07 - Payout/2. Add Account to Payout Whi.description: The account can now receive payouts. Use the seeded sandbox beneficiaries (e.g. {{whitelist_payee}} = 500000001); docs sample accounts are not on this profile's whitelist.

07 - Payout/2. Add Account to Payout Whi.name: Payee already exists (PTL148)
07 - Payout/2. Add Account to Payout Whi.description: (observed) The most common add-whitelist response in production — benign. Re-enable via Update Payser Status if it was disabled.

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/1. Link A.name: Success — QR + deeplink returned (code 00)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/1. Link A.description: The token does NOT come back here: the customer scans/deep-links, approves in ABA Mobile, and PayWay pushes the token (pwt) to your callback_url. Get Token Details is the fallback when the callback is missed. The deeplink scheme is abamobilebank://ababank.com?type=payway&qrcode=<QR_STRING>.

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/2. Link C.name: Success — hosted card-entry HTML (code 00)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/2. Link C.description: Link Card answers with the hosted card-entry PAGE (Visa/Mastercard/JCB/UPI), like Purchase answers with the checkout page. The test script renders the launcher on the Visualize tab; after the customer submits, the token (pwt) arrives via callback_url.
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/2. Link C.body:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>ABA PayWay — Link Card</title></head>
<body>
  <!-- Hosted card-linking form served by PayWay (truncated here).
       Submit posts back to PayWay and the token is pushed to callback_url. -->
  <form id="link-card" method="post">…</form>
</body>
</html>

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/3. Get To.name: Token not linked yet (code 09)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/3. Get To.description: (observed) Expected until the customer completes the ABA-app link — finish that step, then re-send. This endpoint is the fallback when the linking callback was missed; it takes request_id ONLY (no ctid/pwt).

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/4. Paymen.name: Success — charged stored credential (code 00)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/4. Paymen.description: Charges the customer's stored credential ({{pwt}} + {{ctid}}, saved automatically by the token endpoints / Flow B).

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/4. Paymen.name: Invalid or expired token (code 105)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/4. Paymen.description: (observed) The payment credential token is invalid/expired — re-link (link-account/link-card) or renew (account tokens expire 90 days after last use; Renew Token restarts the window).

08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/7. Subscr.name: Success — purchase + token link (code 00)
08 - Credentials on File (CoF)/7. Subscr.description: Subscription = a purchase that also links the customer's card/ABA account. Success returns the checkout QR string; once the customer pays, the token is pushed back for future scheduled charges (CITR_FIX on the purchase path, {{sub_frequency}} = 1W/1M/2M).

09 - KHQR Guideline/1. Create webhook.si.name: Success — receiver bin created
09 - KHQR Guideline/1. Create webhook.si.description: webhook.site's JSON API (NOT api.webhook.site — that host was retired and answers with an unrelated app's JSON). The test saves {{callback_listener}} and {{webhook_token}} for the pull requests.

09 - KHQR Guideline/3. Pull webhook.site.name: Pushback matched — KHQR payment received
09 - KHQR Guideline/3. Pull webhook.site.description: webhook.site pull (paginated {data:[…]} shape; the legacy top-level array is parsed too). PayWay's offline-KHQR pushback is a plain JSON notification — correlate by merchant_ref; there is no per-QR callback field and no hash to verify (inquiry is the source of truth). The test imports the transaction id/status/amounts into the khqr_* variables. Field names illustrative.

09 - KHQR Guideline/3. Pull webhook.site.name: No pushback yet (empty bin)
09 - KHQR Guideline/3. Pull webhook.site.description: The designed 'nothing has paid the QR yet' signal — the KHQR stays PENDING until a human scans and pays it. Re-send this request after paying.

09 - KHQR Guideline/4. Get Transactions.name: Success — KHQR payment found, APPROVED (code 00)
09 - KHQR Guideline/4. Get Transactions.description: KHQRs can be paid MULTIPLE times — the test asserts ≥1 APPROVED row matching {{khqr_merchant_ref}} and cross-checks the amount against the QR. A KHQR can be paid multiple times; one row per completed payment. Sample values illustrative.

09 - KHQR Guideline/4. Get Transactions.name: 404 — profile without KHQR retrieval (demo profiles)
09 - KHQR Guideline/4. Get Transactions.description: (observed) KHQR lookups by reference additionally need KHQR retrieval provisioned on the merchant profile — demo profiles answer 404/empty. The request itself is docs-verified; treat as informational and request provisioning from PayWay.

10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Payment Result.name: What your receiver gets — signed payment callback
10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Payment Result.description: This is the payload the SAMPLE SENDER posts to {{callback_listener}} — the wire format PayWay uses. Verify the X-PayWay-Hmac-Sha512 header: sort keys ascending (apv, return_params, status, tran_id), concat the values (arrays/objects JSON-encoded), HMAC-SHA512 with secret_key, Base64, compare constant-time. status 0/2/3/4/7; apv = approval code. Verify final payment via Check Transaction — a received callback alone is not proof of payment.

10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Token Result C.name: What your receiver gets — CoF token callback
10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Token Result C.description: Sent to callback_url after the customer completes link-account / link-card / renewal. Store pwt + ctid — they are the charge pair for 4. Payment (Using Token). Sample token truncated.

10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Sync webhook.s.name: Pushback pulled — tran_id/pwt/ctid imported
10 - Callbacks & Webhooks/Sync webhook.s.description: webhook.site pull in both response shapes (legacy top-level array and paginated {data}). The test scans the latest callbacks and imports tran_id / pwt / ctid into collection variables so the CoF chain can continue. Content field illustrative.
